items.title: Affordable Xiaomi phone beats $1,500 smartphone in review for a third of the price
items.summary: At $1,500, the new Oppo Reno16 Pro, equipped with the Dimensity 8550, suffers a performance setback in the review. In benchmark tests, it falls short of the Poco Phone, which costs just $380 less. Thanks to its sleek design, top-notch battery life, and long-term software updates, the Oppo phone is still an interesting alternative to the iPhone 17 or Galaxy S26, priced below the MSRP.

items.title: First Wi-Fi 8 gaming router ROG Rapture GT-BN98 launches at a hefty price in North America
items.summary: After teasing its ROG Rapture GT-BN98 router back at the Computex expo, Asus has now released it in North America at a price nearing a grand. This makes it the world's first commercially available Wi-Fi 8 router ahead of the standard's IEEE approval.

items.title: SmallRig launches power banks that bolt straight onto your camera rig

The lineup includes the $59 Nano 36 (10,000mAh, 45W output) and the $80 Nano 72 (20,000mAh, 100W output), both featuring an integrated retractable USB-C cable.

items.title: Nvidia confirms DLSS 5 is coming to RTX 40-series GPUs, but Ada Lovelace owners have no release date yet

The compute-intensive neural rendering technology enhances lighting, shadows, and facial detail, delivering improved visual fidelity at a significant performance cost.
